author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:

Sony is raising prices yet again—this time to PlayStation Plus. The gaming subscription service will go up to $10.99 for a one-month subscription, and $27.99 for a three-month sub. This obviously did not go down well with PlayStation gamers, who have already suffered through PS5 console price hikes. Many are even questioning why a subscription is even necessary to play online games. In other news, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has revealed the latest change to the brand, this time from 'Xbox' to 'XBOX' (note the all-caps). This follows the results of an online poll she posted asking fans if they prefered the regular capitalizaton or the all-caps look. And finally, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has revealed that the original Borderlands underwent a last-minute art style change that cost the company a year in development and an extra $50 million.

As part of IGN’s 30th anniversary celebration, we’re giving away 30 free IGN Live tickets a day. Go to live.ign.com and use code
title: PlayStation Plus Announces Price Hike - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Devil Dinosaur has stomped his way into the Marvel Rivals roster as a powerhouse Vanguard, bringing prehistoric fury to the battlefield. In this deep dive, we break down how to master the newest hero, from his bleed-stacking bite attacks and jaw-clamp crowd control to his devastating trample ultimate. Whether you're looking to protect your team with the Buddy Barrier or unleash chaos with the Inferno Ray, this guide covers every tool in the dinosaur’s primeval kit. 

Mastering Devil Dinosaur requires a mix of aggressive frontline pressure and tactical synergy with allies like the Punisher. This Marvel Rivals strategy guide analyzes his passive displacement immunity, the best ways to utilize his pounce for environmental kills, and high-level tips for Season 8: Sins of Alchemax. We also detail the "Primal Punishment" team-up ability and provide essential counters to ensure you dominate the arena as the game's largest and most formidable tank.
title: Marvel Rivals: Devil Dinosaur Gameplay - Moveset and Strategy Breakdown

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss 'The Wayans' Featurette for Scary Movie, the return of the comedic horror franchise distributed by Miramax and Paramount Pictures. Hear from multiple members of the Wayans family on their inclusion in Scary Movie, in theaters on June 5.

Twenty-six years after outrunning a suspiciously familiar masked killer, the Core Four are back in the killer’s crosshairs and no horror movie IP is safe. Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans, Anna Faris, and Regina Hall reunite in Scary Movie alongside returning favorites and fresh faces to slash through reboots, remakes, requels, prequels, sequels, spin-offs, elevated horror, origin stories, anything with the word legacy in it, and every “final chapter” that absolutely isn’t final. Nothing is sacred. No trope survives. ​Every line gets crossed. The Wayans are back to cancel the Cancel Culture.

Scary Movie stars Marlon Wayans, Damon Wayans, Regina Hall, Anna Faris, Olivia Rose Keegan, Anthony Anderson, and more. The film is directed by Michael Tid
title: Scary Movie - Official 'The Wayans' Behind the Scenes Clip (2026)
